resources.string: Official NordVPN launch & direct ElevenLabs studio access

NordVPN does not provide a public third-party SDK to switch servers or start tunnels externally. Selecting Ireland or Sweden copies the region name and launches the official NordVPN app (or Play Store / web portal) using your own NordVPN account and Android VPN permission.
Access the official ElevenLabs website directly to choose voice characters, enter text, generate speech, play back, and download under your ElevenLabs account.
